title: I didn't read the description well enough...
text: I didn't read the description well enough.... These were a good price and they look good!  I bought them as a gift and when I opened the package I was disappointed to see that they looked and felt like plastic.  When I went back to look at the description, I guess they are sustainably made out of wheat grass or something - which is super cool - but they feel like plastic and I'm concerned that they will get too hot if folks put warm drinks in them.  I didn't test first, so I don't know that for sure.  You just need to know that these do not have a typical mug feel to them.
